---
title: "GB7CAM Network Topology"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
    page-layout: full
---

<div id="network" style="height: 90vh; border: 1px solid #222; background: #0b0f14;"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/vis-network/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js"></script>

<script>
const API = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph";

/* ----------------------------
   NODE COLOR (by family)
---------------------------- */
function nodeColor(id) {
  if (id.startsWith("GB7CAM")) return "#ff6b6b"; // core
  if (id.startsWith("GB7")) return "#4dabf7";     // UK infra
  if (id.startsWith("M7") || id.startsWith("2E1")) return "#51cf66";
  if (id.startsWith("KC2") || id.startsWith("N2") || id.startsWith("ZL")) return "#ffd43b";
  return "#adb5bd";
}

/* ----------------------------
   EDGE COLOUR (by port)
---------------------------- */
function portColor(port) {
  switch(String(port)) {
    case "1": return "#845ef7";
    case "2": return "#20c997";
    case "3": return "#339af0";
    case "4": return "#ff922b";
    default:  return "#868e96";
  }
}

/* ----------------------------
   EDGE WIDTH (quality scaling)
---------------------------- */
function qualityWidth(q) {
  if (!q) return 1;
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(8, q / 40));
}

/* ----------------------------
   EDGE PULSE (active links)
---------------------------- */
function isActive(e) {
  return e.state === "Active" || e.quality >= 250;
}

async function loadGraph() {
  const res = await fetch(API);
  const data = await res.json();

  /* ----------------------------
     Build node map (canonical ID)
  ---------------------------- */
  const nodeMap = new Map();

  (data.nodes || []).forEach(n => {
    nodeMap.set(n.id, {
      id: n.id,
      label: `${n.id}\n${n.alias || ""}`,
      color: nodeColor(n.id)
    });
  });

  /* ensure edge endpoints exist */
  (data.edges || []).forEach(e => {
    if (!nodeMap.has(e.source)) {
      nodeMap.set(e.source, {
        id: e.source,
        label: e.source,
        color: nodeColor(e.source)
      });
    }
    if (!nodeMap.has(e.target)) {
      nodeMap.set(e.target, {
        id: e.target,
        label: e.target,
        color: nodeColor(e.target)
      });
    }
  });

  const nodes = new vis.DataSet([...nodeMap.values()]);

  /* ----------------------------
     Edges
  ---------------------------- */
  const edges = new vis.DataSet(
    (data.edges || []).map((e, i) => {

      const pulse = isActive(e);

      return {
        id: i,
        from: e.source,
        to: e.target,

        arrows: "to",

        label: e.quality ? String(e.quality) : "",

        width: qualityWidth(e.quality),

        color: {
          color: portColor(e.port),
          highlight: "#ffffff"
        },

        dashes: e.quality === 0, // broken routes dashed

        /* subtle pulse effect */
        shadow: pulse,

        font: {
          color: "#c9d1d9",
          size: 10
        }
      };
    })
  );

  const container = document.getElementById("network");

  const network = new vis.Network(container, {
    nodes,
    edges
  }, {
    physics: {
      stabilization: true,
      barnesHut: {
        gravitationalConstant: -8000,
        springLength: 120
      }
    },

    interaction: {
      hover: true,
      tooltipDelay: 200
    },

    nodes: {
      shape: "dot",
      size: 12,
      borderWidth: 1,
      font: {
        color: "#e6edf3"
      }
    },

    edges: {
      smooth: {
        type: "dynamic"
      }
    }
  });

  /* ----------------------------
     LIVE PULSE LOOP
     (fake animation by toggling shadow)
  ---------------------------- */
  setInterval(() => {
    edges.forEach(e => {
      const edge = edges.get(e.id);
      if (!edge) return;

      if (isActive(edge)) {
        edge.shadow = !edge.shadow;
        edges.update(edge);
      }
    });
  }, 1200);
}

loadGraph();
</script>
